body.description: Pixel-art diorama: an intimate lived-in refuge at a dungeon entrance. Broad connected color clusters, compact heroic silhouettes, matte planes, crisp stepped edges, quiet shadow masses and selective details. 8-12 varied mercenaries talk in pairs, share bowls and mend equipment, amid bedrolls, patched cloth and sacks. Exactly ONE small mage stands apart, STRICTLY BACK TO CAMERA, entirely in deep architectural shadow. Opaque black hood and cloak conceal face, skin, hands, hair, age and gender; no rim light. Nobody notices, looks toward or reacts to the mage. Social warmth belongs to others; the mage is excluded from their connections. No war, army, battlefield, ruined city, monsters, epic scale, magic glow, grain, dithering, text, icons or HUD. PLACE: A narrow underground stream separates sleeping bank and cooking bank, joined by a tiny homemade bridge. People share chores on the far bank. Water is a nuisance, not an epic hazard. Dungeon passage hidden behind an overhang. COMPOSITION: Overhead view, diagonal bridge intersects a narrow winding stream, broad quiet stone on one side. COLOR SCRIPT: muted indigo, cool gray stone, dusty rose cloth, small honey lights. Restrained saturation, a legible dark mage silhouette. One complete scene with a quiet dark surrounding field, no decorative frame.
